figurative_meaning_en: Auspicious ceremony performed at the start of an undertaking; a ritual for good fortune
example_sentences_in_bangla: ব্যবসার শুরুতে মঙ্গলাচরণ করে নেওয়া হয়েছে।
বিবাহের আগে মঙ্গলাচরণের অনুষ্ঠান সম্পন্ন হলো।
example_sentences_in_english: A mangalacharan was performed before starting the business.
The mangalacharan ritual was completed before the wedding.
history: Derived from ancient Sanskrit traditions of invoking divine blessings before new ventures, common in Hindu practices.
note: Often involves chanting mantras or puja to ensure success and ward off evil.
